name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited manufactures and sells polyester films in India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers paint protection and sun control films. It also offers defendo-dual reflective, spectrally selective, deco vista, safety, designer, privacy, reflective, IR rejection, writable, antigraffity, and whiteboard films, as well as HP films. In addition, the company provides lidding, liner release, metallized, lamination, packaging, shrink, thermal, heat sealable, graphic, and electrical films, as well as insulation and low oligomer films.
